yt_title: Buy a Powerball Ticket Daily: You'd Win in 800,000 Years
yt_description:
How long would it take to win the Powerball if you bought one ticket every day? About 800,000 years, longer than humans have existed. We ranked 9 rare odds by how long you'd wait at one try a day, from three sixes (about 7 months) to being dealt all 13 spades (1.7 billion years).

Guess before you watch: how many years for the Powerball? Comment your number, then check it at the end.

How it works: on average, odds of 1 in N take N tries, so at one try a day it takes N days.

0:00 800,000 years for a jackpot
0:04 Three sixes
0:11 10 heads in a row
0:17 Four of a kind
0:24 Three natural 20s
0:30 A straight flush
0:37 A 4-letter password
0:43 20 heads in a row
0:50 The Powerball
0:56 All 13 spades

Sources: official Powerball odds; dice, coin and card combinatorics.
